a.lede: The plus-ification of subscription services continues unabated with Amazon becoming the latest company to follow suit with a Kindle Unlimited rebrand. The subscription service is now known as Kindle Plus but will continue to offer unlimited access to a select collection of ebooks, comics, and magazines from the Kindle catalog for $11.99 per month. a.title: Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle Plus and expands access to audiobooks

b.lede: Unlike narrated audiobooks from Audible and other providers, the audiobooks created with Virtual Voice in Kindle+ will instead be narrated by AI.
b.title: Amazon’s Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle+, and the 2 big changes include AI audiobooks
